create_classification_sweep: create a classification hyperparameter sweep with configurable seeds and temperature
create_classification_num_data_sweep: create a classification sweep varying training data sizes from 1 to 100000
create_regression_sweep: create a regression hyperparameter sweep with configurable noise standard deviation
create_problem_config: create a frozen dataclass problem config with prior knowledge, seed, and dataset name
build_sweep_settings: build combined sweep settings dictionary from regression, classification, and num_data sweeps
